meta_title: AI training for business owners in Vadodara | Artificia AI
meta_description: Learn which work in your business AI can take on, and build the first automations yourself. Live in Vadodara, one hour a day, no coding needed.

fields.statement: Put AI to work in your own business.
fields.subheading: Find out what AI can take off your desk, then build the first automations yourself. Live in Vadodara, one hour a day.

fields.heading: What changes in your *business*
fields.intro: Three jobs owners often carry themselves, before and after the course.

items.title: Answering enquiries
items.before: Leads wait hours for a reply while you are busy.
items.after: A WhatsApp bot built in n8n answers common questions and collects details.

items.title: Marketing content
items.before: Posts and creatives wait until someone finds the time.
items.after: Write, design and voice your own content with ChatGPT, Canva and ElevenLabs.

items.title: Your website
items.before: Waiting weeks for someone else to change a page.
items.after: Build and edit a landing page yourself with Lovable or Bolt.new.

fields.heading: How owners use the *course*
fields.intro: Learn the tools first, then the automations that run without you.

steps.title: Start with the Foundation
steps.text: Thirty days on the everyday tools: prompting, content, data and a website.

steps.title: Go on to automation
steps.text: The Full program adds n8n workflows, AI agents, voice agents and RAG over your own documents.

steps.title: Use real business tasks
steps.text: Examples come from real work: enquiries, quotations, reports and follow-ups.

steps.title: Know what to hand over
steps.text: By the end you can build simple automations and judge what a bigger system should do.

fields.heading: What an owner *learns*
fields.intro: The parts of the 60 days that matter most when you run the business.

modules.title: Content, slides and data

modules.title: Websites and simple apps
modules.topics: Landing pages, design and a first internal tool, built by you.

modules.title: Agents and voice agents
modules.topics: How agents work, voice agents that answer calls, and simple backends.

modules.title: n8n automation and WhatsApp bots
modules.topics: Workflows, webhooks, lead generation agents and WhatsApp bots.

modules.title: RAG and agents as a service
modules.topics: AI that answers from your documents, and packaging agents for clients.

items.name: Nilesh Chaudasama
items.quote: The training was practical, structured, and easy to apply in daily professional tasks.

items.question: I run a business. Do I have time for this?
items.answer: Classes are one hour a day. Message us on WhatsApp for batch timings that work around your business.

items.question: Should I learn it or have it built?
items.answer: Learn it if you want to run and change your own tools. If you want a finished system instead, Artificia's services team builds it for you.

items.question: Will I learn to automate WhatsApp?
items.answer: Yes, in the 60-day Full program. Days 36 to 39 cover n8n, webhooks, AI lead generation, and WhatsApp and Telegram bots.

items.question: Can my staff join too?
items.answer: Yes. They can join a batch, or we can run a custom program for your team. Corporate training starts with a free 2-hour pilot.

fields.heading: Ask about the *masterclass*
fields.intro: Tell us about your business and we will suggest a track on WhatsApp.
